prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Write solution.rs with the public function at module scope; use only the standard library.
Required API: pub fn ring_buffer_trace(capacity: usize, values: &[i32]) -> Option<Vec<i32>>
Behavior: Simulate a fixed-capacity FIFO ring. Each value is pushed; emit the evicted oldest value, or -1 when no eviction occurs. Reject non-positive capacity and input value -1, which is reserved as the sentinel. Do not mutate input; empty input succeeds.
Visible example: capacity 2 with values [4,7,9,1] returns [-1,-1,4,7].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: use std::collections::VecDeque;pub fn ring_buffer_trace(capacity:usize,values:&[i32])->Option<Vec<i32>>{if capacity==0{return None}let mut q=VecDeque::new();let mut out=Vec::new();for &v in values{if v== -1{return None}out.push(if q.len()==capacity{q.pop_front().unwrap()}else{-1});q.push_back(v)}Some(out)}
